title: Akuisisi & Preparasi Data (Data Acquisition and Preparation)

title: Data Lake, Warehouse & Lakehouse (Data Lake, Warehouse & Lakehouse)

title: Pemrosesan Paralel & Terdistribusi (+ Tugas-2) (Parallel & Distributed Processing)
